result.question: Quais são os 3 diagnósticos principais mais comuns entre pacientes com mais de 60 anos no estado de MA e no estado do RS?
result.gold_sql: SELECT estado, "CD_DESCRICAO", total FROM (SELECT mu.estado, c."CD_DESCRICAO", COUNT(*) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mu.estado ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE i."IDADE" > 60 AND mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.estado, c."CD_DESCRICAO") sub WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY estado, rn;
result.generated_sql: SELECT mu."estado", c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE mu."estado" IN ('MA', 'RS') AND i."IDADE" > 60 GROUP BY mu."estado", c."CD_DESCRICAO" HAVING ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mu."estado" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) <= 3 ORDER BY mu."estado", total_internacoes DESC;
